        "contents": "const ChatInterface: React.FC\u003cChatInterfaceProps\u003e =\n  ...\n  const searchUsers = async\n\n\n      ...\n\n\n      // Remove duplicates and limit results\n      const uniqueResults = results.filter((result, index, self) =\u003e \n        index === self.findIndex(r =\u003e r.id === result.id)\n      ).slice(0, 10);\n\n      setSearchResults(uniqueResults);\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Error searching users:', error);\n      setSearchResults([]);\n    } finally {\n      setIsSearching(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  // Start new conversation\n  const startNewConversation = async (userId: string, userName: string) =\u003e {\n    setSelectedUser(userId);\n    setShowNewChat(false);\n    setNewChatSearchQuery('');\n    setSearchResults([]);\n    \n    // MessageInput component will handle its own focus\n  };\n\n  // Handle new chat search input\n  const handleNewChatSearch = (e: React.ChangeEvent\u003cHTMLInputElement\u003e) =\u003e {\n    const query = e.target.value;\n    setNewChatSearchQuery(query);\n    \n    // Debounce search\n    if (query.trim()) {\n      setTimeout(() =\u003e searchUsers(query), 300);\n    } else {\n      setSearchResults([]);\n    }\n  };\n\n  // Helper to get user info for conversations/messages\n  const getUserInfo = (userId: string) =\u003e {\n    // Try to find in conversations (from Firestore)\n    const conv = conversations.find(c =\u003e c.userId === userId);\n    if (conv \u0026\u0026 conv.userName \u0026\u0026 conv.userAvatar) {\n      return { name: conv.userName, avatar: conv.userAvatar };\n    }\n    // Try demo users\n    if (demoUsers[userId]) {\n      return { name: demoUsers[userId].displayName, avatar: demoUsers[userId].avatar };\n    }\n    // Fallback\n    return { name: 'Unknown User', avatar: undefined };\n  };",

        "originalContents": "\n\n      // Remove duplicates and limit results\n      const uniqueResults = results.filter((result, index, self) =\u003e \n        index === self.findIndex(r =\u003e r.id === result.id)\n      ).slice(0, 10);\n\n      setSearchResults(uniqueResults);\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Error searching users:', error);\n      setSearchResults([]);\n    } finally {\n      setIsSearching(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  // Start new conversation\n  const startNewConversation = async (userId: string, userName: string) =\u003e {\n    setSelectedUser(userId);\n    setShowNewChat(false);\n    setNewChatSearchQuery('');\n    setSearchResults([]);\n    \n    // MessageInput component will handle its own focus\n  };\n\n  // Handle new chat search input\n  const handleNewChatSearch = (e: React.ChangeEvent\u003cHTMLInputElement\u003e) =\u003e {\n    const query = e.target.value;\n    setNewChatSearchQuery(query);\n    \n    // Debounce search\n    if (query.trim()) {\n      setTimeout(() =\u003e searchUsers(query), 300);\n    } else {\n      setSearchResults([]);\n    }\n  };\n\n  // Helper to get user info for conversations/messages\n  const getUserInfo = (userId: string) =\u003e {\n    // Try to find in conversations (from Firestore)\n    const conv = conversations.find(c =\u003e c.userId === userId);\n    if (conv \u0026\u0026 conv.userName \u0026\u0026 conv.userAvatar) {\n      return { name: conv.userName, avatar: conv.userAvatar };\n    }\n    // Try demo users\n    if (demoUsers[userId]) {\n      return { name: demoUsers[userId].displayName, avatar: demoUsers[userId].avatar };\n    }\n    // Fallback\n    return { name: 'Unknown User', avatar: undefined };\n  };",

        "originalContents": "\n\n  // Search for users to start new chat\n  const searchUsers = async (query: string) =\u003e {\n    if (!query.trim()) {\n      setSearchResults([]);\n      return;\n    }\n\n    setIsSearching(true);\n    try {\n      // Search in users collection\n      const usersQuery = firestoreQuery(\n        collection(db, 'users'),\n        where('displayName', '\u003e=', query),\n        where('displayName', '\u003c=', query + '\\uf8ff'),\n        limit(10)\n      );\n      \n      // Search in crewProfiles collection\n      const crewQuery = firestoreQuery(\n        collection(db, 'crewProfiles'),\n        where('name', '\u003e=', query),\n        where('name', '\u003c=', query + '\\uf8ff'),\n        limit(10)\n      );\n\n      const [usersSnapshot, crewSnapshot] = await Promise.all([\n        getDocs(usersQuery),\n        getDocs(crewQuery)\n      ]);\n\n      const results: Array\u003c{\n        id: string;\n        name: string;\n        avatar?: string;\n        role?: string;\n        company?: string;\n        location?: string;\n        type: 'user' | 'crew';\n      }\u003e = [];\n\n      // Add users\n      usersSnapshot.docs.forEach(doc =\u003e {\n        const data = doc.data() as any;\n        if (doc.id !== currentUserId) { // Don't show current user\n          results.push({\n            id: doc.id,\n            name: data.displayName || data.firstName || &#96;User ${doc.id.slice(-4)}&#96;,\n            avatar: data.avatarUrl,\n            role: data.role,\n            company: data.company,\n            location: data.location,\n            type: 'user'\n          });\n        }\n      });\n\n      // Add crew members\n      crewSnapshot.docs.forEach(doc =\u003e {\n        const data = doc.data() as any;\n        if (doc.id !== currentUserId) { // Don't show current user\n          results.push({\n            id: doc.id,\n            name: data.name || data.firstName || &#96;Crew ${doc.id.slice(-4)}&#96;,\n            avatar: data.avatarUrl,\n            role: data.role,\n            company: data.company,\n            location: data.location,\n            type: 'crew'\n          });\n        }\n      });",

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "      .no-conversation {\n        flex: 1;\n        display: flex;\n        flex-direction: column;\n        align-items: center;\n        justify-content: center;\n        color: #9ca3af;\n        text-align: center;\n\n        .text-6xl {\n          font-size: 72px;\n          margin-bottom: 16px;\n        }\n\n        h3 {\n          font-size: 20px;\n          font-weight: 600;\n          color: #6b7280;\n          margin: 0 0 8px 0;\n        }\n\n        p {\n          font-size: 14px;\n          margin: 0;\n        }\n      }\n    }\n  }\n}\n\n// Animations\n@keyframes messageSlideIn {\n  from {\n    opacity: 0;\n    transform: translateY(20px);\n  }\n  to {\n    opacity: 1;\n    transform: translateY(0);\n  }\n}\n\n@keyframes typingBounce {\n  0%, 80%, 100% {\n    transform: scale(0.8);\n    opacity: 0.5;\n  }\n  40% {\n    transform: scale(1);\n    opacity: 1;\n  }\n}\n\n@keyframes spin {\n  0% { transform: rotate(0deg); }\n  100% { transform: rotate(360deg); }\n}\n\n@keyframes slideDown {\n  from {\n    opacity: 0;\n    transform: translateY(-10px);\n  }\n  to {\n    opacity: 1;\n    transform: translateY(0);\n  }\n}\n\n@keyframes pulse {\n  0%, 100% {\n    opacity: 1;\n  }\n  50% {\n    opacity: 0.5;\n  }\n}\n\n@keyframes blink {\n  0%, 50% {\n    opacity: 1;\n  }\n  51%, 100% {\n    opacity: 0.3;\n  }\n}\n\n@keyframes voiceWave {\n  0%, 100% {\n    height: 20px;\n  }\n  50% {\n    height: 40px;\n  }\n}\n\n// Responsive design\n@media (max-width: 768px) {\n  .chat-interface {\n    padding: 10px;\n    \n    .chat-container {\n      border-radius: 12px;\n      \n      .chat-sidebar {\n        width: 280px;\n      }\n    }\n  }\n}\n\n@media (max-width: 640px) {\n  .chat-interface {\n    .chat-container {\n      flex-direction: column;\n      \n      .chat-sidebar {\n        width: 100%;\n        height: 40%;\n        border-right: none;\n        border-bottom: 1px solid #e5e7eb;\n      }\n      \n      .chat-area {\n        height: 60%;\n      }\n    }\n  }\n}\n\n// User Profile Modal\n",

        "originalContents": "      .no-conversation {\n        flex: 1;\n        display: flex;\n        flex-direction: column;\n        align-items: center;\n        justify-content: center;\n        color: #9ca3af;\n        text-align: center;\n\n        .text-6xl {\n          font-size: 72px;\n          margin-bottom: 16px;\n        }\n\n        h3 {\n          font-size: 20px;\n          font-weight: 600;\n          color: #6b7280;\n          margin: 0 0 8px 0;\n        }\n\n        p {\n          font-size: 14px;\n          margin: 0;\n        }\n      }\n    }\n  }\n}\n\n// Animations\n@keyframes messageSlideIn {\n  from {\n    opacity: 0;\n    transform: translateY(20px);\n  }\n  to {\n    opacity: 1;\n    transform: translateY(0);\n  }\n}\n\n@keyframes typingBounce {\n  0%, 80%, 100% {\n    transform: scale(0.8);\n    opacity: 0.5;\n  }\n  40% {\n    transform: scale(1);\n    opacity: 1;\n  }\n}\n\n@keyframes spin {\n  0% { transform: rotate(0deg); }\n  100% { transform: rotate(360deg); }\n}\n\n@keyframes slideDown {\n  from {\n    opacity: 0;\n    transform: translateY(-10px);\n  }\n  to {\n    opacity: 1;\n    transform: translateY(0);\n  }\n}\n\n@keyframes pulse {\n  0%, 100% {\n    opacity: 1;\n  }\n  50% {\n    opacity: 0.5;\n  }\n}\n\n@keyframes blink {\n  0%, 50% {\n    opacity: 1;\n  }\n  51%, 100% {\n    opacity: 0.3;\n  }\n}\n\n@keyframes voiceWave {\n  0%, 100% {\n    height: 20px;\n  }\n  50% {\n    height: 40px;\n  }\n}\n\n// Responsive design\n@media (max-width: 768px) {\n  .chat-interface {\n    padding: 10px;\n    \n    .chat-container {\n      border-radius: 12px;\n      \n      .chat-sidebar {\n        width: 280px;\n      }\n    }\n  }\n}\n\n@media (max-width: 640px) {\n  .chat-interface {\n    .chat-container {\n      flex-direction: column;\n      \n      .chat-sidebar {\n        width: 100%;\n        height: 40%;\n        border-right: none;\n        border-bottom: 1px solid #e5e7eb;\n      }\n      \n      .chat-area {\n        height: 60%;\n      }\n    }\n  }\n}\n\n// User Profile Modal\n",

+ // Test script for chat functionality
+ // Run this in the browser console to test chat features
+ 
+ const testChat = {
+   // Test Firebase connection
+   async testConnection() {
+     console.log('🔍 Testing Firebase connection...');
+     try {
+       const { db } = await import('../src/firebase');
+       const { collection, getDocs, limit } = await import('firebase/firestore');
+       
+       const testQuery = collection(db, 'directMessages');
+       const snapshot = await getDocs(testQuery);
+       console.log('✅ Firebase connection successful');
+       console.log('📊 Found', snapshot.docs.length, 'messages in database');
+       return true;
+     } catch (error) {
+       console.error('❌ Firebase connection failed:', error);
+       return false;
+     }
+   },
+ 
+   // Test message sending
+   async testMessageSending() {
+     console.log('📤 Testing message sending...');
+     try {
+       const { MessagingService } = await import('../src/utilities/messagingService');
+       
+       const testMessage = {
+         senderId: 'test-user-1',
+         receiverId: 'test-user-2',
+         content: 'Test message from script',
+         messageType: 'text'
+       };
+       
+       const messageId = await MessagingService.sendDirectMessage(
+         testMessage.senderId,
+         testMessage.receiverId,
+         testMessage.content,
+         testMessage.messageType
+       );
+       
+       console.log('✅ Message sent successfully with ID:', messageId);
+       return messageId;
+     } catch (error) {
+       console.error('❌ Message sending failed:', error);
+       return null;
+     }
+   },
+ 
+   // Test conversation loading
+   async testConversationLoading() {
+     console.log('💬 Testing conversation loading...');
+     try {
+       const { MessagingService } = await import('../src/utilities/messagingService');
+       
+       const conversations = await new Promise((resolve) =&gt; {
+         const unsubscribe = MessagingService.subscribeToConversations('test-user-1', (convs) =&gt; {
+           unsubscribe();
+           resolve(convs);
+         });
+         
+         // Timeout after 5 seconds
+         setTimeout(() =&gt; {
+           unsubscribe();
+           resolve([]);
+         }, 5000);
+       });
+       
+       console.log('✅ Conversations loaded:', conversations.length);
+       return conversations;
+     } catch (error) {
+       console.error('❌ Conversation loading failed:', error);
+       return [];
+     }
+   },
+ 
+   // Run all tests
+   async runAllTests() {
+     console.log('🚀 Starting chat tests...');
+     
+     const results = {
+       connection: await this.testConnection(),
+       messageSending: await this.testMessageSending(),
+       conversationLoading: await this.testConversationLoading()
+     };
+     
+     console.log('📋 Test Results:', results);
+     
+     const passed = Object.values(results).filter(Boolean).length;
+     const total = Object.keys(results).length;
+     
+     console.log(&#96;🎯 Tests passed: ${passed}/${total}&#96;);
+     
+     if (passed === total) {
+       console.log('🎉 All tests passed! Chat should work correctly.');
+     } else {
+       console.log('⚠️ Some tests failed. Check the errors above.');
+     }
+     
+     return results;
+   }
+ };
+

+ # Chat Troubleshooting Guide
+ 
+ ## Issue: Chat is stuck in "generating" state
+ 
+ ### Quick Fixes
+ 
+ 1. **Refresh the page** - This often resolves temporary connection issues
+ 2. **Check your internet connection** - Ensure you have a stable connection
+ 3. **Clear browser cache** - Clear cookies and cache for your site
+ 4. **Try a different browser** - Test in Chrome, Firefox, or Safari
+ 
+ ### Debug Steps
+ 
+ #### 1. Check Browser Console
+ Open Developer Tools (F12) and look for errors in the Console tab:
+ - Red error messages indicate JavaScript errors
+ - Yellow warnings may indicate connection issues
+ - Look for Firebase-related errors
+ 
+ #### 2. Use the Debug Component
+ 1. Go to the Chat Test Page
+ 2. Click "🔧 Show Debug" button
+ 3. Review the diagnostic information
+ 4. Check if Firebase connection is successful
+ 
+ #### 3. Run Console Tests
+ In the browser console, run:
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;javascript
+ // Test all chat functionality
+ testChat.runAllTests()
+ 
+ // Or test individual components
+ testChat.testConnection()
+ testChat.testMessageSending()
+ testChat.testConversationLoading()
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ ### Common Issues &amp; Solutions
+ 
+ #### Firebase Connection Issues
+ **Symptoms:** "Failed to initialize chat" or connection timeouts
+ **Solutions:**
+ - Check Firebase configuration in &#96;src/firebase.ts&#96;
+ - Verify environment variables are set correctly
+ - Ensure Firestore is enabled in your Firebase project
+ - Check Firestore security rules
+ 
+ #### Permission Errors
+ **Symptoms:** "Permission denied" errors in console
+ **Solutions:**
+ - Check Firestore security rules
+ - Ensure user is authenticated
+ - Verify collection permissions
+ 
+ #### Real-time Listener Issues
+ **Symptoms:** Messages not updating in real-time
+ **Solutions:**
+ - Check network connectivity
+ - Verify Firestore indexes are created
+ - Restart the application
+ 
+ #### Message Sending Issues
+ **Symptoms:** Messages appear to send but don't arrive
+ **Solutions:**
+ - Check message permissions
+ - Verify receiver exists in database
+ - Check for rate limiting
+ 
+ ### Advanced Debugging
+ 
+ #### 1. Check Network Tab
+ 1. Open Developer Tools → Network tab
+ 2. Try to send a message
+ 3. Look for failed requests to Firebase
+ 4. Check response status codes
+ 
+ #### 2. Monitor Firestore
+ 1. Go to Firebase Console → Firestore
+ 2. Watch the &#96;directMessages&#96; collection
+ 3. Check if messages are being written
+ 4. Verify data structure
+ 
+ #### 3. Test with Different Users
+ 1. Try logging in with a different account
+ 2. Test sending messages between different users
+ 3. Check if the issue is user-specific
+ 
+ ### Prevention
+ 
+ #### 1. Implement Proper Error Handling
+ The updated code now includes:
+ - Timeout protection (10-15 seconds)
+ - Automatic retry mechanisms
+ - Better error messages
+ - Graceful degradation
+ 
+ #### 2. Monitor Performance
+ - Watch for memory leaks
+ - Monitor listener cleanup
+ - Check for infinite loops
+ 
+ #### 3. Regular Testing
+ - Test chat functionality regularly
+ - Monitor error rates
+ - Keep Firebase SDK updated
+ 
+ ### Emergency Recovery
+ 
+ If chat is completely broken:
+ 
+ 1. **Restart the application**
+ 2. **Clear all browser data**
+ 3. **Check Firebase status** at https://status.firebase.google.com/
+ 4. **Rollback to previous version** if needed
+ 5. **Contact support** with debug information
+ 
+ ### Debug Information to Collect
+ 
+ When reporting issues, include:
+ - Browser and version
+ - Console error messages
+ - Network request failures
+ - Debug component output
+ - Steps to reproduce
+ - User ID and timestamp
+ 
+ ### Performance Optimization
+ 
+ The updated code includes:
+ - Timeout protection for all async operations
+ - Better memory management
+ - Improved error recovery
+ - Retry mechanisms
+ - Graceful degradation
+ 
+ This should resolve most "generating" state issues and provide better error handling for future problems.
